newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues term tender to buy 1997-98 kerosene.
newsitem.headline: India issues term tender to buy 1997-98 kerosene.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a one-year term tender to buy superior kerosene oil for delivery from May 1997 to April 1998, traders said on Monday.

The tender seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, and 30,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Bombay on the west coast, both on a cost-and-freight basis.
The tender closes on March 13 and offers will be valid until March 17.
